csv_project_name: AE for Community Resilience Center Conceptual Design Study
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Redding ( City ) is seeking proposals from qualified architectural consultants ( Consultant ) to provide preliminary conceptual design services for a proposed Community Resilience Center (Project) of approximately 25,000 square feet in Redding, California located at 2515 and 2551 South Market Street, 2553 and 2541 Angelo Avenue, and 1145 State Street (APN 104-280-063- 000, 104-280-065-000, 104-280-036-000, 104-280-035-000 and 104-280-034-000) These parcels, when combined, are approximately 2.32-acres in development size. The purpose of this project is to develop a conceptual site and building plan to support long-range planning, stakeholder engagement, funding applications, and future design phases. This solicitation is limited to conceptual planning and preliminary architectural design. Detailed engineering, construction documents, and permitting services are not included in this scope and may be procured separately at a later date. The following are possible design elements of the Project that may be incorporated due to funding source or other requirements: Private Office Spaces (8-10) Classroom/conference room Food Storage/Kitchen Flex room for resource center services (medium classroom size) Basketball Courts (up to 5) 94 x 50 NBA/College size (with space for seating) Restrooms/changing rooms Outdoor area for children & garden (min 150 sf) Childcare facility The City has received planning funding to evaluate the development of a Community Resilience Center that would support community services, emergency preparedness, workforce development, recreation, and related activities. The proposed facility may include a combination of uses such as: Offices and administrative space Classrooms and training rooms Community gathering spaces Indoor recreation or sports areas Outdoor space Support spaces (restrooms, storage, etc.) Associated parking and site circulation The intent of this project is to establish a preliminary vision, building footprint, and site layout sufficient to inform decision-making, a preliminary review of the project by City staff and future funding opportunities. The primary objectives of this effort are: Identify spatial needs and relationships for major program components Develop a conceptual building layout and site plan Illustrate how the proposed facility could be accommodated on the site Provide graphics suitable for stakeholder engagement and presentations Develop a planning-level opinion of probable cost Estimate the maximum occupancy of the various uses or combinations of uses of the facility to support preliminary application review. The Project will also have design elements that incorporate a blending of the Parkview Avenue business corridor and existing residential areas that make up the Parkview Neighborhood. The Project should enhance the quality of life for the tenants of the Project and the neighborhood in general. The following services are not included in this solicitation: Civil engineering design Structural engineering Mechanical, electrical, or plumbing engineering Surveying or geotechnical services Construction documents Permitting or regulatory approvals Detailed site engineering Off-street parking and other City site development standards or proposed alternatives consistent with Redding Municipal Code
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design

title: AE for Community Resilience Center Conceptual Design Study
short_description: Conceptual design study for a 25,000-square-foot community resilience center in Redding, California.
project_location: Redding, California, USA; 2515 and 2551 South Market Street, 2553 and 2541 Angelo Avenue, and 1145 State Street.
project_scope: Conceptual planning and preliminary architectural design for a proposed Community Resilience Center of approximately 25,000 square feet on a combined 2.32-acre site. The study is to develop a conceptual site and building plan, preliminary vision, building footprint, site layout, graphics for stakeholder engagement, planning-level probable cost, and occupancy estimates. Possible program elements include 8-10 private offices, classroom/conference room, food storage/kitchen, flex room, up to 5 basketball courts sized about 94 x 50 ft with seating space, restrooms/changing rooms, outdoor children's area and garden of at least 150 sf, childcare facility, parking, and site circulation.
services: Preliminary conceptual design services including architectural programming, conceptual site and building planning, preliminary architectural design, interior space planning, landscape architecture, land use planning, master planning, urban planning/design, graphics for stakeholder engagement, planning-level cost opinion, and occupancy estimation. Excludes civil, structural, MEP, surveying, geotechnical, construction documents, permitting, and detailed site engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Building project with only conceptual architectural planning scope.
- No structural engineering services are included in this solicitation.
- Facility includes indoor recreation/sports components, but structural complexity is not defined.
- Moderate strategic relevance as an early-stage building concept where sbp could potentially team with architects.
- Lower priority because it is a general community building rather than a clearly complex, long-span, or iconic structure.
construction_cost_explanation: taken from the tender documents; however, the stated total construction cost of 60.0K appears unusually low for a 25,000 sf facility and may reflect planning-study budget data rather than actual construction cost.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee information is provided. The tender is limited to conceptual architectural services only; no separate structural engineering fee is stated.
references_qualifications: Qualified architectural consultants are requested. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the source text.
contracting_authority: City of Redding, Redding, California, USA. Contact: Michelle Kempley. Phone: 530-225-4002. Fax: 530-224-6071. Email: mkempley@cityofredding.gov. Website: https://www.cityofredding.gov/_T65_R567.php
notes: Project number 5697; IMS Project #861444-1; ProjectID 1007150. Questions deadline: 2026-05-08 05:00 PM PDT. The source lists disciplines including rehabilitation/refurbishment and planning, but the stated scope is a conceptual design study for a new or redeveloped community resilience center. The listed construction cost should be treated with caution due to likely inconsistency with project size and program.
